title: Spectral determinants of the Bolza surface and the Klein quartic
summary: We obtain closed explicit formulas for the spectral determinants of the smooth hyperbolic Bolza surface and the Klein quartic. In each case, a multiplicative relation expresses the determinant of the surface in terms of determinants of singular quotient orbifolds of genera zero and one. The elliptic factors are evaluated by applying the singular Polyakov anomaly formula to explicit Belyi maps on CM elliptic curves of discriminants -8 and -7, while the genus-zero factors are evaluated by explicit determinant formulas for constant-curvature spheres with conical singularities.
